zh: embedding 与位置机制初始化每个 token 的 residual state
causal self-attention 通过 query-key routing 混合过去位置的 value，MLP 再做位置内计算
context 可见性不保证可靠检索，消息角色也不是权限隔离
最后位置的 residual state 经 unembedding 形成下一 token logits
en: Embeddings and positional mechanisms initialize each token's residual state
Causal self-attention mixes values from prior positions through query-key routing, followed by per-position MLP computation
Context visibility does not guarantee reliable retrieval, and message roles are not permission isolation
The final position's residual state is unembedded into next-token logits
